description.value: The Gambier Community Centre is a registered charity and the only public facility on Gambier Island, the largest island in Howe Sound, BC, home to roughly 100 permanent residents year-round. The island has no car-ferry access — only a passenger ferry runs between Langdale and New Brighton — giving it a distinctly remote, low-traffic character that touring cyclists who make the crossing would find unusual. As the island's sole community hub, the centre organizes events and is the only place on the island where credit and debit cards are accepted.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (gambierisland.org) describes the Gambier Community Centre as a registered charity and 'the only public facility' on Gambier Island, accessible only by passenger ferry with no car-ferry service. The website content is an island-wide portal and provides no detail on cycling amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water, or showers are not mentioned anywhere in either the website or OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null. The site was updated 11 May 2026 and describes active organizations and events, confirming the centre is operational.
concerns: Website is an island-wide portal with no dedicated community centre amenities page — cycling facilities (washrooms, water, bike parking) are entirely unverifiable from available content.
No phone number present in OSM or on website for the community centre directly.
Island is accessible only by passenger ferry (Langdale–New Brighton); no car-ferry service significantly limits the cycling audience.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: As the only public facility on a passenger-ferry-only, car-free island, this centre could be a critical stop for cyclists who make the crossing, but no cycling amenities are confirmed from the website and the WWC fit cannot be determined without on-the-ground verification.
enrichment_extras.notes: Hall rental is listed in the site navigation, suggesting the facility is bookable. The centre accepts credit and debit cards — the only such option on an island with no ATM.

wow_evidence: The only public facility on Gambier Island — genuine island commons with a real public role.
blurb: Gambier Island's one public community facility.
